restaurant_name: คลินิกหมอประภาพร เวชกรรมเฉพาะทาง สูติ-นรีแพทย์
text: I've had irregular periods for nearly three years. No one has been able to find the cause, and they only prescribed medication. I finally found the doctor here, Dr. Prapaporn. She diagnosed the condition and sent me for an ultrasound at Sripath Hospital. The cause was clearly identified. She's incredibly skilled. I'd like to thank her so much. The cost of the test was not expensive, and the staff at the counter were very friendly and encouraged me, telling me to stay strong and that I'd get better. No one else had ever told me anything like that before. I was so discouraged. It was excruciating. In the end, I had to have surgery to get better. I'd like to thank the staff at the counter and all the assistants so much.

text: I had a comprehensive cervical cancer screening done online. They said I would receive the results via LINE within two weeks. Two weeks passed, and I didn't receive anything. When I inquired, they responded slowly. I finally received the results after three weeks, only stating that there was a minor abnormality and that I needed to see a doctor again in six months. I explained that I wasn't available as I'm currently abroad and asked for details about what the minor abnormality was. I also requested a copy of the test results, but they refused. I paid for this screening; it wasn't free. They should have been more attentive. Please provide complete and detailed information.
author_name: วิมาลา มาเยอะ
